command:
set -u; echo '=== HOST ==='; hostname; date -Is; id -un; echo HOME=$HOME; echo '=== LOAD ==='; uptime; echo '=== CANDIDATE REPOS ==='; for d in "$HOME/frankenstein-repo" "$HOME/frankenstein-2.0" "$HOME/.claude/star" /home/*/frankenstein-repo /home/*/frankenstein-2.0; do [ -e "$d" ] || continue; echo --- $d; if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then git -C "$d" status --short --branch 2>&1 | head -80; git -C "$d" log -8 --oneline --decorate 2>&1 | head -20; else find "$d" -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%TY-%Tm-%Td %TH:%TM %f
' 2>/dev/null | sort -r | head -30; fi; done; echo '=== AVATAR/ANIMATION RECENT FILES ==='; find "$HOME" -maxdepth 5 -type f \( -iname '*avatar*' -o -iname '*face*' -o -iname '*eye*' -o -iname '*animation*' -o -iname '*body*' -o -iname '*sprite*' \) -mmin -2880 -printf '%TY-%Tm-%Td %TH:%TM:%TS %s %p
' 2>/dev/null | sort -r | head -160; echo '=== FRANK/CLAUDE LIVE PROCESSES ==='; ps -eo pid,lstart,pcpu,pmem,cmd --sort=-pcpu | grep -Ei 'claude|frank|avatar|python|node' | grep -v grep | head -80; echo '=== GRID/HOOK STATE HINTS ==='; find "$HOME/.claude" -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -iname '*grid*' -o -iname '*hook*' -o -iname '*raum*' \) -mmin -1440 -printf '%TY-%Tm-%Td %TH:%TM %p
' 2>/dev/null | sort -r | head -100
